text: You’re in a busy place, just trying to get somewhere. You feel like a flowing element, moving easily with the crowd, on your way.
Suddenly, you're stuck. A wall of bodies. You press, shuffle, but go nowhere. The flow around you has completely stopped. What happened?
You search for a reason. Did someone just stop ahead? It feels random, frustrating, like an unseen force holds you back.
It wasn't a single stop. It's a ripple. A small slowdown ahead caused people to get closer. Density increases, movement slows, propagating backwards like a wave.
You're caught in this density wave. It's not a personal blockade; it's an emergent property of the crowd itself. The cost is your time and patience.
The jam clears, you're moving again. Next time, you'll see it differently. Anticipate these ripples, understand crowd physics, and flow.
